cues: Rainwater flows through the garden beds, soaking the soil before draining into a shallow pond.
The orchestra warms up with slow scales while the audience finds seats in the auditorium.
Fresh dough rests beneath a cloth until yeast fills it with tiny air pockets.
Migrating geese circle above the marsh before descending among reeds at sunset.
A watercolor wash dries in layered bands, leaving pale edges around the painted clouds.
